tools.name: search_candidates
tools.description: Searches Hire Overseas's pool of remote professionals in the Philippines, Latin America and Africa for a role and returns up to 5 candidate profiles in seconds. Profile text is redacted and pseudonymous: first name, country, skills and experience; never a surname, contact detail or employer name. Ea

tools.name: scope_role
tools.description: Reads a job description (text or an https link) or a few sentences about a role and returns a structured brief (must-have and nice-to-have skills, years, regions, budget), the questions it leaves open, and a ballpark monthly cost. Ask the user the openQuestions, then pass the brief to search_candida

tools.name: get_candidate_resume
tools.description: Returns a candidate from search_candidates: the public profile (first name, country, headline, experience, skills, work history). With lead_token (from verify_email) it also returns the candidate's anonymized Hire Overseas résumé as text, with no surname, contact details, links, employer names, city

tools.name: salary_benchmark
tools.description: Returns a ballpark monthly range in USD for a full-time (or part-time) remote hire through Hire Overseas for a role, from the Hire Overseas rate card, adjusted by real placement data for the region when there is enough of it. A range for the role, not the price of any candidate. Hire Overseas works

tools.name: savings_estimate
tools.description: Compares the fully loaded yearly cost of a US hire (base salary × 1.3 for taxes, benefits and overhead) with the Hire Overseas ballpark for the same role, and returns the yearly savings range and percentage. Without a salary it uses a typical US salary for the role. A ballpark, not a quote: Hire Ove

tools.name: request_intro
tools.description: Requests an introduction to a candidate returned by search_candidates. The request goes to the Hire Overseas team, who verify the candidate, confirm availability and pricing, and reply to the contact email, usually within one business day. Requires the requester's real company name and work email. O

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Returns pending_review, approved or rejected for a request made with request_intro.

tools.name: submit_email
tools.description: Starts email verification so the user can see branded resumes and videos or request introductions. Hire Overseas emails a 6-digit code to the address; then ask the user in chat for the code and call verify_email. Use the user's own work email; personal addresses are accepted but flagged.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Checks the 6-digit code the user received after submit_email. On success returns a leadToken: pass it as lead_token to Hire Overseas tools that ask for it for the rest of the conversation. Codes expire after 10 minutes and allow 5 attempts.

tools.name: create_shortlist
tools.description: Saves up to 12 candidates from search_candidates as a private Hire Overseas shortlist page and returns its link (shortlistUrl) for the user to share with colleagues. Each person who opens it confirms their own work email first. Every candidate is checked again now; ones no longer available are left

tools.name: save_search
tools.description: Saves a candidate search for the verified user. Every Monday Hire Overseas runs it again and, when there are new candidates, emails the user up to 5 of them (with a one-click unsubscribe). Takes the same search arguments as search_candidates plus a title. At most 5 saved searches per email. Requires

tools.name: list_saved_searches
tools.description: Lists the saved searches (weekly candidate emails) for the verified user, with their ids. Requires lead_token.

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.description: Deletes one of the verified user's saved searches, which stops its weekly email. Requires lead_token.

tools.name: get_booking_slots
tools.description: Returns up to 8 open times in the next 7 days for a free strategy call with the Hire Overseas team, each with a booking link, plus a general booking link. With lead_token the links are prefilled with the user's verified name and email. Show the times in the user's timezone and let them pick; booking

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scope_role, get_candidate_resume, save_search, list_saved_searches, delete_saved_search, get_booking_slots · Private data: search_candidates, get_candidate_resume, request_intro, create_shortlist · Public sink: scope_role, get_candidate_resume, request_intro, submit_email, verify_email, create_shortlist, save_search, delete_saved_search, get_booking_slots · Destructive: delete_saved_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scope_role, get_candidate_resume, save_search, list_saved_searches, delete_saved_search, get_booking_slots · Private data: search_candidates, get_candidate_resume, request_intro, create_shortlist · Public sink: scope_role, get_candidate_resume, request_intro, submit_email, verify_email, create_shortlist, save_search, delete_saved_search, get_booking_slots · Destructive: delete_saved_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
